cues: After a past reporting verb, every tense moves one step back.
I write becomes he said he wrote.
I am writing: he was writing.
I have written: he had written.
I was writing: he had been writing.
I will write: he would write.
And the past perfect stays as it is, because there is no further step back.
text: After a past reporting verb, every tense moves one step back. I write becomes he said he wrote. I am writing: he was writing. I have written: he had written. I wrote: he had written. I was writing: he had been writing. I will write: he would write. And the past perfect stays as it is, because there is no further step back.
